product_from_film: Zora Autosell is presented as automatically selling part of a coin holding as its price reaches higher multiples.
explains_well: The repeated 2x, 4x and 8x states, autosold notices and balance view make the automatic-sale idea visible.
unclear: The film does not show how to enable the rule, define its reference price or inspect the remaining holding after each sale.
scenario: A coin profile leads to rising price multiples, 20% autosale notices and an increasing account balance.
product_clear_basis: At 12s, a 2x label accompanies a notice that 20% was autosold; later multiples repeat that relationship.

categories.finding: The main automatic-selling concept survives silently, but setup and reference-price details remain missing.
The portrait anchors the middle while large multiples attract attention; decorative dollar symbols compete with the smaller sale notice.
The short sequence repeats the rule effectively but accelerates to large gains without clarifying the changing remaining position.
Automatic sells are illustrated by repeated notices; the win-more ending adds an outcome claim beyond the shown mechanism.
Bright rings and larger values suggest excitement and easy reward; audience response is unmeasured.
The portrait and circular motif connect several scales of view, though balance growth is not reconciled with a transaction ledger.
The multiples, earnings and balance are illustrative film states, not verified returns. Execution, fees, rule basis, remaining position and performance were not tested.
The coin profile, blue autosell wordmark and circular selling motif make the feature visually recognizable.
Add setup and one complete sale example.
